title: Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors
main_claim: Generalised Abundance (Lazić–Peternell): if (X,B) is a projective klt Q-pair in characteristic 0, K_X+B is pseudo-effective, M is nef Q-Cartier and K_X+B+M is nef, then K_X+B+M is numerically equivalent to a semiample Q-Cartier divisor. The key new step: on a klt Calabi–Yau pair, a nef divisor of full nef dimension is big.

issues.location: Sec. 2 (Theorems input:abundance, input:models); used throughout Secs. 3, 6, 7
issues.description: The main theorem is conditional on companion preprints. [LA] is cited for full log abundance for lc pairs. [MM] is cited for terminating MMPs for generalized klt pairs with b-nef data. Both are major open conjectures that this paper does not prove. The case M=0 is literally the abundance input. This is an external dependence, not an internal gap.
issues.evidence: Prelim.: 'Theorem (Log abundance, [LA, Thm 1.1]) ... If K_X+B is nef, then it is semiample.' Also: 'For M=0, the conclusion is therefore equivalent to ordinary klt abundance, which is an input to this proof.'

issues.location: Sec. 4 (Lemmas j:subadjunction, j:base-component, j:moving-kernel, j:fiber-restriction, j:finite-covers)
issues.description: Five technical lemmas are imported from [LA, Lemmas 7.1–7.5] with proof sketches only. These are the moving-jet-kernel lemma (ordinary-power containment I_V^h along moving base components), generic subadjunction, fibre restriction and finite covers with a fixed branch complement. The whole Seshadri and scalar-bound machinery rests on them, so the paper cannot be verified independently of LA.
issues.evidence: 'We use the following five results from the section Tools for moving base components of [LA].'

sibling_notes: Same family as rank61 (Minimal models in numerical dimension one), which was also no_gap_found and also leans on companion OpenAI LogAbundance. This paper takes full log abundance and generalized-MMP termination from the companions LA and MM, and imports LA Lemmas 7.1–7.5 and Thm 9.1 (Frobenius, reproved here). Any defect in LA's moving-kernel lemma (7.3) would propagate here. Note that Cor 1.2 would imply strong open statements such as the SYZ/Lagrangian fibration conjecture for hyperkähler manifolds (nef isotropic implies semiample). That is a reason to scrutinize LA closely.
